schedule: nonoverlapping 128-token CPU FP32 eager full forwards; cache reset at every window
selection: first 8192 tokenized suffix tokens in corpus order; no outcome-based text selection
targets: 127 next-token targets per window; 2032 calibration and 6096 test targets
qualification: source must beat both memory-off and head-mean by >=1% relative PPL, with paired-window bootstrap lower delta-NLL bound >0 on calibration
test_use: report independent confirmation; never select backend, threshold or checkpoint on test
compression_followup: only pursue quality/capacity competition if calibration qualifies; small table cannot establish large-memory storage value
head_mean: unweighted FP32 mean over all actual trained rows within each original hash head; no text or labels used
corpus_pretraining_boundary: excluded from TinyEngram branch training; Qwen pretraining overlap is unknown
cost_scope: offline CPU qualification, no GPU, no data-fetch or usage fees; elapsed time is not a backend latency benchmark
